H9_spec.note: RE-KEYED after scoring, applied identically to every model. R4 (must reassign on lease expiry) contradicts BOTH R2 (at most once) and R11 (never concurrent), because R5 says a partitioned worker keeps running and cannot tell. R2 is the strictly stronger requirement, so R2+R4 is at least as good as the originally intended R4+R11. 7 of 9 runs across all three models answered R2+R4. The original key was wrong, not the models.

F05_fab2.note: KEY CORRECTED after scoring: the largest exactly-representable integer in IEEE 754 binary64 is 2^1024 - 2^971, not 2^53 (that is the largest N below which every integer is representable). Every model answered correctly; the original key was wrong. Both readings are now accepted.
